{{Quote|I knew I could count on you. Just deliver this lightsaber to the Nightsister Trujhazii. It will bring peace between us. The other Nightsisters are a little upset about the whole affair&mdash;don't let any of them give you any trouble.|Singular Nak|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Trujhazii''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] who lived during on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trujhazii was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
